hero.headline: Obsessed with design.<br class="break-medium"> Passionate about getting it right.

intro.imageAlt: Ezrah working at his laptop in a home studio
intro.heading: I’ve been designing since before I knew what to call it.
intro.body: Graphics, full brands, and everything in between. My friends just call me the “design guy”.

about.heading: A little bit about the design guy.
about.paragraph1: I started by pirating design software off my high school computer. The rest is history.
about.paragraph2: Since then, design has never really been something I do. It’s something I can’t stop doing. Whether it’s a brand identity, graphics for a sports team, a vibe-coded tide tracker for my parents’ cabin, or just a fun passion project to teach myself something new, I care about it all the same.
